ex_ret_instr.name: ex_ret_instr
ex_ret_instr.justification: perf list (amdzen3): Retired Instructions; the generic PERF_COUNT_HW_INSTRUCTIONS on family 19h (0x00c0, amd_zen2_perfmon_event_map, arch/x86/events/amd/core.c, Linux v7.0; sysfs events/instructions). A mechanism's instructions per call must not change with the distribution.

ls_not_halted_cyc.name: ls_not_halted_cyc
ls_not_halted_cyc.justification: perf list: Cycles not in Halt; the generic PERF_COUNT_HW_CPU_CYCLES on family 19h (0x0076).

ex_ret_brn.name: ex_ret_brn
ex_ret_brn.justification: perf list: Retired Branch Instructions; the generic PERF_COUNT_HW_BRANCH_INSTRUCTIONS on family 19h (0x00c2; sysfs events/branch-instructions).

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of branch instructions retired. This includes all types of architectural control flow changes, including exceptions and interrupts

ex_ret_brn_misp.name: ex_ret_brn_misp
ex_ret_brn_misp.justification: perf list: Retired Branch Instructions Mispredicted; the generic PERF_COUNT_HW_BRANCH_MISSES on family 19h (0x00c3; sysfs events/branch-misses).

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of retired branch instructions, that were mispredicted

ex_ret_brn_ind_misp.name: ex_ret_brn_ind_misp
ex_ret_brn_ind_misp.justification: perf list: Retired Indirect Branch Instructions Mispredicted; 'each such mispredict incurs the same penalty as a mispredicted conditional branch instruction; only EX mispredicts are counted'. Separates target mispredictions of the indirect call from direction mispredictions.

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of indirect branches retired that were not correctly predicted. Each such mispredict incurs the same penalty as a mispredicted conditional branch instruction. Note that only EX mispredicts are counted

ex_ret_ind_brch_instr.name: ex_ret_ind_brch_instr
ex_ret_ind_brch_instr.justification: perf list: Retired Indirect Branch Instructions. One per call is expected for indirect and hinted, zero for branch and branchless (returns are counted separately).

perf_list.BriefDescription: Retired Indirect Branch Instructions. The number of indirect branches retired

bp_dyn_ind_pred.name: bp_dyn_ind_pred
bp_dyn_ind_pred.role: use of the dynamic indirect predictor
bp_dyn_ind_pred.justification: perf list: Dynamic Indirect Predictions. Shows whether the indirect call's predictions came from the history-based indirect predictor at all.

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of times a branch used the indirect predictor to make a prediction

ex_ret_msprd_brnch_instr_dir_msmtch.name: ex_ret_msprd_brnch_instr_dir_msmtch
ex_ret_msprd_brnch_instr_dir_msmtch.justification: perf list: Retired Mispredicted Branch Instructions due to Direction Mismatch (event 0x1c7: config bits 0-7 = 0xc7, bits 32-35 = 0x1 by the PMU's sysfs format).

perf_list.BriefDescription: Retired Mispredicted Branch Instructions due to Direction Mismatch
perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of retired conditional branch instructions that were not correctly predicted because of a branch direction mismatch

ex_ret_near_ret.name: ex_ret_near_ret
ex_ret_near_ret.justification: perf list: Retired Near Returns. One per call is expected wherever an operation is called.

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of near return instructions (RET or RET Iw) retired

ex_ret_near_ret_mispred.name: ex_ret_near_ret_mispred
ex_ret_near_ret_mispred.justification: perf list: Retired Near Returns Mispredicted. A control: returns are predicted by a return-address stack, so they should not depend on the selector.

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of near returns retired that were not correctly predicted by the return address predictor. Each such mispredict incurs the same penalty as a mispredicted conditional branch instruction

bp_de_redirect.name: bp_de_redirect
bp_de_redirect.justification: perf list: Decode Redirects. A control for front-end redirects that are not execute-time mispredictions.

perf_list.PublicDescription: The number of times the instruction decoder overrides the predicted target
